caption: A loss over $4.66M is expected on no more than 1% of trading days.

eyebrow: Three ways to estimate the same number

steps.label: Parametric
steps.sub: assumes normal returns; fast, but tail-light

steps.label: Historical simulation
steps.sub: replays real past returns on today's book

steps.label: Monte Carlo
steps.sub: simulates many scenarios from a richer model

steps.label: Tail-blind
steps.sub: says nothing about losses beyond the threshold

steps.label: Not sub-additive
steps.sub: combined VaR can exceed the sum of the parts

steps.label: Expected Shortfall
steps.sub: averages the tail instead of just marking it

subtitle: What statistical risk measures can't tell you, stress tests can.
